title: MS Office and Keyboard Shortcuts for Exams: Quiz

questions.question: What is the default file extension of an Excel workbook saved in Excel 2007 or later?
questions.rationale: .xlsx is the default. .xls is the older binary format and .xlsm holds macros.

questions.question: Which key starts a PowerPoint slide show from the first slide?
questions.rationale: F5 starts from the beginning; Shift + F5 starts from the current slide, the usual trap. Ctrl + M inserts a new slide.

questions.question: Which shortcut opens the Replace dialog in Word?
questions.rationale: Ctrl + H is Replace. Ctrl + F is Find, Ctrl + R right-aligns and Ctrl + K inserts a hyperlink.

questions.question: Cells A1 to A5 contain 12, 8, 15, 5 and 10. What does =AVERAGE(A1:A5) return?
questions.rationale: The sum is 50 and 50 divided by 5 is 10. 50 is the SUM result.

questions.question: In Excel, the last column of a worksheet (2007 onward) is named:
questions.rationale: There are 16,384 columns and the last is XFD. IV was the last column of the old .xls format (256 columns).

questions.question: Which function counts all cells that are not empty in a range?
questions.rationale: COUNTA counts non-empty cells of any type; COUNT counts only cells containing numbers.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a PowerPoint extension?
questions.rationale: .docx belongs to Word. The other three are PowerPoint presentation, show and template files.

questions.question: Which key combination switches between open windows in Windows?
questions.rationale: Alt + Tab switches windows. Alt + F4 closes the active window and Windows + L locks the PC.

questions.question: A range A1:C4 in Excel contains how many cells?
Which Excel error appears when a formula divides a number by zero?
questions.rationale: #DIV/0! is the division error. #NAME? means an unrecognised name and #REF! an invalid reference.

questions.question: Which statement is correct?
options: Animations control how one slide moves to the next
Transitions control how objects move on a slide
Transitions control the change from one slide to the next
Slide Sorter view is used to run the show
questions.rationale: Transitions are slide-to-slide effects; animations act on objects within a slide. Slide Sorter is for rearranging slides.

questions.question: The F4 key pressed while editing a formula in Excel does what?
options: Cycles between relative and absolute references
questions.rationale: F4 toggles forms like A1, $A$1, A$1 and $A1. F2 edits the cell and F7 checks spelling.

questions.question: Which shortcut deletes a selected file permanently without using the Recycle Bin?
questions.rationale: Shift + Delete skips the Recycle Bin after confirmation. Plain Delete only moves the file to it.

questions.question: Which Word tab contains the Mail Merge feature?
questions.rationale: Mail Merge is in the Mailings tab. References holds table of contents and footnotes.

questions.question: The shortcut Ctrl + Shift + ; in Excel inserts:
questions.rationale: Ctrl + ; inserts the date and Ctrl + Shift + ; inserts the time.
